title: EasyDesign NK2R sentinel plus BenchBB seven-target fresh Gate3 acceptance
scope: One fresh design-only attempt per target from Gate1 through validated design YAML freeze.
precedence: For authority_id easydesign-gate3-fresh-v1, this file is the sole protocol authority.

cohort_success_reporting.engineering_completion: Report completion over all eight targets.
cohort_success_reporting.benchbb_statistics: Compute BenchBB aggregate statistics over the seven BenchBB targets only; NK2R is an engineering sentinel, not a BenchBB target.

freshness_contract.required_head: The resolved freeze_ref commit; no source, prompt, skill, config, protocol, input or metric change is allowed after the first attempt starts.
freshness_contract.tracked_tree: Clean at every attempt start. The pre-existing untracked protected audit is excluded from project state and must remain byte-untouched.
freshness_contract.project_state: Every attempt uses a never-before-existing project path, thread, run ID and runtime-state path. No old SQLite, dossier, candidate, transcript, project artifact or scientific cache is copied or resumed.
freshness_contract.retry: Product-native retry/resume inside the same unchanged attempt is measured. A failed fresh attempt is retained; any replacement uses a new r2/r3 identity.
freshness_contract.invalidation: Any protected change after cohort start invalidates the complete v1 cohort. Create v2 and restart all eight targets from Gate1.

execution.load_policy: Start at most two agents when 1-minute load is below 75; reduce to one at 75-84; start none at 85 or above. Pause launches for less than 300 GiB available memory, provider 429s or repeated transport timeouts.

gate_policy.gate1: Approve the highest-ranked selectable identity/structure/chain option only when identity, species, mapping and provenance hard checks pass. Otherwise stop.
gate_policy.gate2_default: For each BenchBB target, approve the highest-ranked selectable candidate. Keep the complete A/B/C candidate set in the record. Do not override a blocked candidate.

gate2_nk2r.selection: From the fresh selectable options, choose the candidate that is extracellular, faces the orthosteric pocket and occupies the deeper outer-pore/deep-pocket entrance rather than the shallow outer vestibule.
gate2_nk2r.fresh_id_rule: Use the exact option_id produced by the fresh Gate2 card. Do not hard-code rank, candidate letter or residue IDs from a historical run.
gate2_nk2r.failure_rule: If no selectable fresh candidate matches this semantic site, stop NK2R as a scientific failure. Do not fall back to candidate A and do not override.

gate3.normal_approval: Approve only when hard_constraints=passed, every backend validation passed, blockers is empty and generation_started=false.
gate3.soft_override: One explicit override is allowed only when every remaining item is a displayed soft warning and the card is otherwise override-eligible.
gate3.override_reason_scope: Authorize validated design YAML freeze only; do not authorize Pilot, handoff, BoltzGen generation, binding or functional claims.

targets.goal: Design an extracellular inhibitory VHH nanobody against human NK2R (TACR2).
Design a VHH nanobody against the human PD-L1 extracellular domain that is intended to inhibit PD-1 engagement.
Design a VHH nanobody against Epstein-Barr virus BHRF1 that targets the accessible BH3-binding cleft and is intended to inhibit pro-survival ligand engagement.
Design a VHH nanobody binder against the de novo beta-barrel protein BBF-14 using an accessible, structurally coherent surface epitope.
Design a VHH nanobody binder against maltose-binding protein using an accessible, structurally coherent epitope.
Design a VHH nanobody against the human IL-7 receptor alpha extracellular domain that is intended to inhibit IL-7 receptor engagement.
Design a VHH nanobody against the human EGFR ectodomain that is intended to inhibit ligand-driven receptor activation.
Design an inhibitory VHH nanobody against Streptococcus pyogenes Cas9 using an accessible, functionally relevant surface site.
